text: The Chatbot Sandbox is a small practice AI you can chat with. There is nothing to download. It can be wrong, and that is the point: you practise catching its mistakes.
Agree to the terms
The first time you open the sandbox, ARAW shows the terms. Read them, then press I agree. You need the internet to chat, but there is nothing to download.
The Before you chat pop-up: a list of terms that starts with do not share personal details, and the buttons Not now and I agree.
The most important rule: keep personal details out.
Press this when you have read the terms.
Not now keeps the chat closed. You can still practise in Module 3.
If the practice AI cannot answer, ARAW tells you why. You can try again later, save the AI on your device, or practise in Module 3.
Your messages go over the internet to an AI service to get an answer. ARAW does not save them, and the chat is cleared when you leave the page. Do not write names, ID numbers or addresses.

Your messages go over the internet to an AI service to get an answer. ARAW does not save them, and the chat is cleared when you leave this page. Keep personal details out.
Do not share personal details: no real names, phone numbers, addresses, ID numbers or health records, yours or anyone else's.
What you type is sent over the internet to an AI service (Cloudflare Workers AI) to get an answer. ARAW does not save your chats. The service says it does not keep them or use them to train AI.
This AI can be wrong and can make things up. It is for learning only. Check what it says before you believe it.
It is not a doctor. Do not use it for medicine doses, diagnosis or emergencies. Ask a health worker. In an emergency, call 911.
Use it kindly. Do not use it to harm anyone or for anything against the law.
If you are a minor, use it with a parent, guardian or teacher.
